mapper.sql: select p.id, p.instance_id, p.customer_id, p.node_name, p.node_type, p.address, p.port, p.listen_port, p.ws_key, p.subscription_token, p.url, p.config_json, p.domain_policy_json, p.expire_time, p.custom_id, p.status, p.remark, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, case when p.ws_key is not null then (select w.stage from res_ws_operation w where w.instance_id = p.instance_id and (w.kind = 'FORCE_VPS' or (w.node_id = p.id and w.kind in ('DELETE','FORCE'))) and w.state not in ('DONE','FAILED') order by w.sequence_no desc limit 1) end as cleanup_stage, (select ifnull(sum(ifnull(t.rx_delta, 0) + ifnull(t.tx_delta, 0)), 0) from res_proxy_node_traffic t where t.node_id = p.id) as total_traffic_bytes from res_proxy_node p
mapper.select: where expire_time is not null and expire_time < #{maxExpireTime} and (status = '0' or status is null) order by expire_time asc
where expire_time is not null and expire_time >= #{fromTime} and expire_time <= #{toTime} and (status = '0' or status is null) order by expire_time asc
where instance_id = #{instanceId} and coalesce(listen_port, port) = #{port} limit 1
select count(1) from res_proxy_node where instance_id = #{instanceId}
select count(1) from res_proxy_node where customer_id = #{customerId}
mapper.insert: insert into res_proxy_node (instance_id, customer_id, node_name, node_type, address, port, listen_port, ws_key, subscription_token, url, config_json, domain_policy_json, expire_time, custom_id, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{instanceId}, #{customerId}, #{nodeName}, #{nodeType}, #{address}, #{port}, #{listenPort}, #{wsKey}, #{subscriptionToken}, #{url}, #{configJson}, #{domainPolicyJson}, #{expireTime}, #{customId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete:
delete from res_proxy_node where id in
#{id}
